newsitem.title: GREECE: German sends piece of Parthenon back to Greece.
newsitem.headline: German sends piece of Parthenon back to Greece.

text.p: A German souvenir stealer has sent back to Greece a piece of marble taken from the Parthenon many years ago, the government reported on Friday.
A Ministry of Culture statement said the Greek ambassador in Bonn received a package with the stone and an anonymous letter saying it was from the 5th century BC Athens landmark.

"This stone belongs to Greece. Many years ago I took it from the Acropolis and now I return it. Because of my age I will not travel to Athens any more so I would like to ask you to place it again near the Parthenon," the letter said.
The statement said the stone would be brought to Athens in a diplomatic bag and the embassy would send a letter to the German press thanking the sender.
